6991-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
6991-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-2511-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

341-4399-4518-8333.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Umori.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Sickbay trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sickbay trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
341-4399-4518-8333.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2317-4247-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1580-2842-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-2842-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Blood Artist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6006-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-4247-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5078-6666.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

6797-7084-7885.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1355-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
1355-4091-7791.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

1734-2511-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3025-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2613-4083-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver is indestructible.
2613-4083-4090.description:
Deal damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Spiteful Sliver trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Spiteful Sliver instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

973-2921-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

826-1766-3767-3918.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2

539-2511-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

262-1491-5231-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

586-2438-5258-5618-6580.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1789-2921-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2921-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

465-643-969-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

360-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-2981-5687-5691.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

372-813-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3446-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

719-3510-3678.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-3678.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Xenograft, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat step 3.

245-2351.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
You have a way to interrupt the loop after drawing your library.
245-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn by triggering Marneus Calgar using his activated ability, or by any other method.
The Watcher in the Water triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
After drawing any number of cards, interrupt the mandatory infinite loop by winning the game or removing a combo piece in response to a trigger.
